title: Apricot and Raspberry Pizza
steps: Roll or stretch the dough to ⅛–½ inch thick. Slice the apricot ¼–½ inch thick and halve the raspberries.
Coat the dough with olive oil. Arrange the apricot slices and raspberries with space between them. Dot with butter and sprinkle with cinnamon and brown sugar.
Bake at 600–650°F until the crust is evenly browned and the sugar and exposed fruit caramelize.
Rest for a few minutes, then slice. Serve as is or with vanilla ice cream and a drizzle of cream sherry or port.
reviewFlags: The general directions suggest 4–6 Tbsp brown sugar, while the specific ingredient list calls for ¼ cup. Confirm the desired amount.
